biggest_catch: Earnings are variable and effort-based: OhmConnect's own marketing cites typical earnings of $100–$300/year, and what you actually earn depends on how much energy you save during OhmHour events. It's not a guaranteed payout — it's pay-for-performance for cutting usage.
catches: Earnings are not guaranteed — they depend on how much energy you save during each OhmHour event.
You must connect your utility account (PG&E, SCE, SDG&E in California; also NY and Texas) with a smart meter.
OhmHours require you to actively reduce usage for about 30–60 minutes when notified — miss events, earn nothing.
Points convert to PayPal cash or gift cards; the $20 referral only pays when your friend joins and connects their account.
Earnings depend on grid events in your area — some weeks have more OhmHours than others.

c1.evidence: OhmConnect is a real operating demand-response company; the program is described on ohmconnect.com.

c2.evidence: Official OhmConnect page states: earn points by saving energy during OhmHours, cash out via PayPal or gift cards, $20 per referral.

c3.evidence: Free to join; no fee stated on the official page.

c4.evidence: Official page states points can be cashed out via PayPal or as gift cards; typical $100–$300/year cited by the company (via press).

eligibility: Residential customer of a participating utility (PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E in California; select utilities in New York; OhmConnect also operates as a retail electricity provider in Texas) with a smart meter. Connect your utility account through the OhmConnect signup.
notes: Verified from the official OhmConnect page on 2026-09-23. Earnings are real cash via PayPal — but variable and participation-dependent, which is stated honestly throughout (no income framing; biggest_catch carries the variability warning).
payout_quote: Earn points for saving energy during OhmHours — cash out via PayPal or as gift cards (company cites typical $100–$300/year); $20 for each friend who joins.

steps: Create a free OhmConnect account on ohmconnect.com.
Connect your utility account (PG&E, SCE, SDG&E, or a participating NY/TX utility) through the secure authorized connection.
When you get a text/email about an upcoming OhmHour, confirm participation and cut your energy use for the event (about 30–60 minutes).
Earn points based on how much you saved versus your forecast — points post after each event.
Cash out your points via PayPal or as gift cards; refer friends to earn $20 each.
timing: Points post after each OhmHour event; cash out via PayPal or gift cards whenever you choose.
